name: features/voice-conversation.md publishes two contradictory barge-in statements — the microphone cannot be live during playback (:50-54) and paused during playback (:182-183)
description:
PUBLISHED DEFECT found by the read-only biblio verdict (card 68566d25), measured 2026-11-24 on `docs/` at 7b52488d854e+dirty. `features/voice-conversation.md` is committed and identical to HEAD (not part of the pending increment), so this text is live on the public docs site.

THE CONTRADICTION (both sentences are in the same file, both published):

1. `:50-54` — "**Barge-in**: if you start speaking while codx-junior is answering, playback stops immediately and the microphone listens again. Only the user's speech triggers it: the assistant's own words picked up by the microphone are filtered out. It uses the speech recognizer (with a microphone-level fallback) and is skipped when muted or when voice input is unavailable."
2. `:182-183` (Limitations) — "The call listens and speaks sequentially (**the microphone is paused while codx-junior speaks**) to avoid transcribing its own voice."

Barge-in requires the microphone to be OPEN and transcribing while codx-junior speaks (that is how the first user syllable stops playback). The limitation says the microphone is PAUSED while codx-junior speaks. Both cannot be true. The "filtered out" clause in :52-53 suggests the real implementation keeps the mic live and discards the assistant's own voice — in which case :182-183 is the stale sentence.

WHAT TO DO
- Read the actual behaviour in the voice call implementation (`api/` voice/session code and the client call panel). The docs-only tool jail cannot reach it, so this card needs a shell/code-capable run.
- Correct exactly one of the two sentences so both describe the same behaviour. Prefer keeping the one that matches the code; do not rewrite the rest of the page.
- One-sentence edit, no reformatting, no unrelated cleanup.

ACCEPTANCE
- The two passages are no longer mutually exclusive, and the corrected sentence names the real mechanism (mic live + assistant-voice filter, OR mic paused).
- `features/voice-conversation.md` still reads within its section and keeps its heading level and list style.

COORDINATION
- Part of the docs increment that is on HOLD pending D3 (card 0a654767 / ec0a31db context). Do not publish this page as part of the pending +253 increment; this is an independent one-line fix on an already-published page.
- Guard context: card 49007737 (T4 route-claim guard) and d0908965 (16 prefix waivers) cover route claims, not prose contradictions like this one.
